games.title: Benny Says
games.description: A simon says style game where you need to match the growing sequence every round

games.title: Benny's Baseball
games.description: A full baseball simluation game with no reaction needed, simply make choices and play a full season of baseball.

games.title: Benny's Basketball Shooter
games.description: A fun basketball shooting game with special bonus mode to try to get the highest score possible.

games.title: Benny's Football
games.description: Pick your team color and play a 16-game season of football! Call your plays, time your passes, and win 10 games to make the single-elimination playoffs - or go 16-0 for a straight shot at the championship.

games.title: Benny's Battle Boats
games.description: A classic battleship-style game where you place your fleet and try to sink the enemy's ships. Play against the computer or challenge a friend in 2-player mode!

games.title: Benny's Bowling
games.description: A fun simple bowling game with physics and realistic sound effects. Choose your a ball style or fun background theme.

games.title: Benny's Bug Blaster
games.description: A tower defense style game where you squash bugs with your boot and have to buy items to keep your defenses up against the bugs.

games.title: Benny's Chess and Checkers
games.description: Play classic Chess or Checkers against the computer or with a friend!

games.title: Benny's Connect Four
games.description: Drop pieces and connect four in a row to win! Play against the computer or challenge a friend.

games.title: Benny's Matchy Match
games.description: Previously called concentration. A fun matching game with competitive modes and cooperative play. This comes with an editor app to make your own games!

games.title: Benny's Mini Golf
games.description: A top-down minigolf game you can play with up to four people. The balls have collision on so have fun smacking eachothers balls around! This game has a level editor to create your own golf courses.

games.title: Benny's P3GL Game
games.description: A peggle style game with a campaign/level editor built in. Have fun making different kinds of peg blasting games!

games.title: Benny's Tic Tac Toe
games.description: Play tic tac toe against the computer or against your friends.

games.title: Benny's Dice
games.description: A 3D dice game with Free Throw, Yarkle, and Fahtzee modes. Roll dice with realistic physics!

games.title: Benny's Word Jumble
games.description: A word puzzle game where you have to rearrange the word to advance.

games.title: Trivia Master
games.description: A trivia game engine that lets you build your own trivia games! Add pictures and videos to make it more fun!

games.title: Benny's Mega Slot
games.description: A fun casino-style slot machine game with bonus modes, multiple themes, and exciting sound effects!

games.title: Pickleball Rally
games.description: Rally against the computer by scanning to the right side of the court and returning every serve. In collaboration with SCSU, student creator: Lily Flack.

games.title: Benny's Show n Sound
games.description: A spinning wheel See 'n Say. Pick a category, spin the wheel, and hear each panel's name and sound when it lands.

games.title: Benny's Ballista
games.description: Lay siege to castles with a giant crossbow! Pick your angle and power from a list, watch the dotted arc show you exactly where the bolt lands, and bring the towers down. No timing and no rush - every shot is your choice.

games.title: Benny's Race Tracks
games.description: A 3D racing game you steer with a single switch - the game tells you which way to go with arrows, sound, and speech. Race 10 levels in a car, motorcycle, or spaceship, or pick the no-fail Cruise mode and just collect things along the way.

games.title: Benny's FishMaster
games.description: Cast a line into procedurally generated lakes, work a self-paced catch sequence to land your fish, and sell your catch to buy better rods and bait. No timing, no reaction speed - just pick your spot and reel it in.
